title: Delhi Police claims CCTV footage of ACP molesting journalist is AI-generated, arrests Haryana man
key_facts: Delhi Police arrested a man from Haryana's Palwal for allegedly circulating a fabricated video falsely showing a senior officer misbehaving with a woman journalist.
Additional DCP Manjeet Sheoran says the accused used AI tools to generate the 'CCTV footage' and that a technical test confirmed it was AI-generated.
Police say the man first posted it on 3 October and circulated it on 4 October, causing agitation among protesters.
He was booked under several BNS sections on rioting and forgery and presented in court on Monday; police are checking funding and a possible larger conspiracy.
No FIR has been filed against the officer over the journalist's allegation; apart from the purported footage, no proof of the alleged incident has emerged.
The journalist's complaint, made while covering a protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, says the officer groped and shoved her.
quote_evidence: “The Instagram and Facebook page News aina was circulating an AI-generated CCTV image of a Delhi Police senior officer misbehaving with a woman. On being alerted by the cyber wing of New Delhi district police we ran a technical test which further confirmed that it was an AI-generated video,” said Additional DCP Sheoran.

why_it_matters_hint: Police say an AI fake was spread during a live dispute, which complicates a real complaint.
notes: Police claim only; ThePrint saw a screenshot but not an independent verification. Officer and accused not named in the entry.
